name: project-init
description: Cowork project lifecycle for MoxyWolf projects. /init-project scaffolds tailored Project Instructions. /session-start auto-resolves the project — explicit argument, then launch directory, then the most recently active project, never a picker — mounts the three standard roots, reads the previous session's handoff including the `author` / `for` baton-pass fields, and probes the team-shared OpenRouter key (DR-010). /session-end asks who authored the handoff and whether it's a baton-pass, writes the canonical handoff with `author` / `for` frontmatter, supports --author / --handoff-to / --solo, refreshes each writable repo's README.md, then runs /obsidian-update. v0.15.0 closes the stale-handoff-reminder propagation hole: /session-start now reads Taskade/_Shared Files/_shared-memory/INDEX.md as a first-class briefing step and cross-checks the handoff's procedural-reminders section against the current INDEX, flagging any reminder that cites a missing or revised file as STALE. /session-end now requires every general behavioral reminder in the procedural-reminders section to cite a currently-existing team-shared memory file by exact filename (verified at write time), or be explicitly tagged as (session-specific). Together the two checks stop free-form recollections from overriding canonical team-shared memory across sessions — the failure mode that surfaced 2026-06-02 when a 2026-05-21 handoff carried forward a 'never run git from the sandbox' reminder that had been reversed 2026-05-20.
